name: Churn retention manager
tagline: Steps in on cancellations and failed payments before you lose the customer
description: Watches for the two moments a subscriber is about to disappear, someone clicking cancel and a card that did not go through, and intervenes while there is still something to be done. It puts a meaningful alternative in front of them rather than a token discount, then logs the reason behind each departure.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
